data.why: The literature CSVs are only consumed by pytest validation tests, not by the Streamlit UI, so they are copied as reference artifacts; the hand-written example_assembly.json matches the StackAssembly dataclass schema and preset names so it can be uploaded via the 'Load assembly JSON' file_uploader on the Assembly tab.

goals: Pick cell materials (membrane, anode/cathode catalyst, GDLs) from the literature-referenced preset library and view the resulting polarization curve
Size a stack by setting cell count and active area, then read off stack-level KPIs (U_stack, P_electric, m_H2/h, energy efficiency)
Check thermal management: waste heat, required coolant flow, and exothermic/endothermic mode at a chosen operating point
Design the physical stack assembly (bipolar plate, end plate, current collector, gasket, tie-rod) and inspect the to-scale cross-section and flow-field top view
Save a stack assembly configuration to JSON and reload it later to resume or share a design
Export the polarization curve and operating-point summary as CSV for external reporting
Sanity-check the physics model against bundled literature polarization-curve datasets (Bernt 2020, Zimmer 2026) via the test suite

review.summary: What's in the tree is accurate and well built, and the 11 screens I opened show what the nodes say. But a dependency clash in our environment (pyarrow needing NumPy 2 against the repo's numpy<2 pin) crashed every tab after the first chart, so thermal checks, physical assembly, JSON save/load and CSV export are all missing. Fix the install and re-run to add those phases before filing.
